market: Erie County, New York launch; services can be sold nationally; founder confirms online-only operation at launch
canonical_policy: One indexable URL per distinct buyer job. All listed paths are proposed and require actual site implementation. Do not create Buffalo and Erie County duplicates for the same service intent. Use self-referencing canonicals on published pages, one preferred HTTPS hostname, and permanent redirects from retired equivalent paths. Canonicals do not substitute for distinct content.
launch_target: 9 essential commercial pages plus one privacy utility page; up to 3 evidence-ready guides; optional care route only after support readiness. Core is 10 actual URLs including privacy, target 13 including three guides, or 14 with care.

home_interactions.desktop: Web Design, SEO, Pricing, Work, and Contact are direct header links: one activation from home.
home_interactions.mobile: One menu activation, then one visible link activation to Web Design, SEO, Pricing, Work, Contact, Process, About, or Erie County; a separate persistent contact link can reach Contact in one activation.
home_interactions.rule: No hover dependency, nested service submenu, carousel, modal, or accordion between home and a key commercial page. Keyboard and screen-reader operation must match touch routing.

navigation.conditional_care_link: /services/website-care/ only after the offer and delivery checks pass
navigation.breadcrumb_rule: Home > Web design, Home > SEO, Home > Guide title, Home > Project title. Link an intermediate hub only if that real useful hub is published; no empty /services/ or /guides/ routes.
navigation.internal_link_rule: Each service links to Pricing, at least one relevant proof or truthful demonstration, Contact, and its closest guide. Each guide links to one primary service and Pricing or Contact when useful. Work entries link back to the service they demonstrate. County page links to service pages and Contact; services link back to county only where geographic logistics help the buyer. Use descriptive anchors and ordinary href links in HTML.

keyword_inventory_routes.rule: Development, redesign, WordPress migration and municipality modifiers stay on one design page while the offer is one custom-build scope.
Local SEO, technical SEO and AI-search questions are sections of the active SEO offer; no separate promise of AI citations.
Informational process questions link back to the commercial SEO offer.
Includes legacy unmatched 'website redesign cost buffalo'; exact offer prices live on Pricing.
Only location/logistics queries go primarily to county; commercial service queries go to service.
Publish a dedicated care URL only after the actual care offer and operations pass readiness; otherwise pricing describes it as unavailable or limited.
Keep repair/migration questions in a scoped web-design section until a distinct priced, supported rescue offer exists.

query_family: Buffalo web design and SEO studio

pages.primary_intent: Commission a custom website or redesign
pages.evidence_gate: Actual scope, starting investment and exclusions, ownership and handoff, founder role, inspectable work or labeled demonstration
Actual work process, monthly capacity and exclusions, sample report or properly labeled owned-site evidence, no ranking promises

pages.primary_intent: Compare this studio's current website and SEO prices
secondary_intent: how to obtain a scoped quote
pages.evidence_gate: Approved offer table with explicit scope, exclusions and estimate caveats; no invented market average

pages.primary_intent: Understand how a custom website or SEO engagement works
pages.evidence_gate: Real delivery stages and client obligations consistent with actual contracts and capacity

pages.primary_intent: Inspect what the founder can actually do
pages.evidence_gate: At least one real inspectable owned project or completed labeled demo; paid client outcomes only with permission; no empty cards

pages.primary_intent: Learn who is responsible for strategy and delivery
pages.evidence_gate: Verified founder credentials and actual location/remote work model
Form fields and privacy text approved; real end-to-end delivery test; no false response promise

pages.evidence_gate: Plain online-only delivery model and concise municipality index; no office, in-person meeting, local case or travel claim

pages.main_cta: See current website scope and pricing

pages.primary_intent: Understand what monthly SEO work and reporting look like

pages.evidence_gate: Actual or explicitly illustrative report with no fictional client outcome

pages.primary_intent: Buy supported website maintenance and care
pages.evidence_gate: Supported stack, written scope, real restore drill, report sample, response and cancellation terms verified; otherwise cover care briefly on Pricing and defer URL

pages.primary_intent: Understand actual inquiry and analytics data practices
pages.evidence_gate: Actual processors, retention, contact and privacy choices documented and reviewed

deferred_routes.gate: Real distinct local buying question, authorized firsthand project or relationship, original place-specific artifacts, observed inquiry/query demand, and a useful standalone page; no city-by-service matrix
Distinct priced, supported repair offer with acceptance test and capacity; otherwise one web-design FAQ section
Project details, role and permission verified; accurately label owned work, concept or paid client
Do not publish while intent and scope overlap web-design; reconsider only with distinct offer and evidence
Do not publish as duplicate service targets; route relevant terms to canonical service URLs

v5_build_rule: Keyword primary_url is intended destination, not a publish instruction. Resolve to the listed published fallback while a route is gated. publication_stage is not a quota. Core is9commercial+privacy; up to3readyguides and conditionalCare. No automaticrescue/municipality/project URLs.
